description: Run Godot 4.7 headless on the project: import, load and instantiate every script and scene, and optionally run the main scene (or the `scene` you name) for `run_frames` frames and return what it printed. Reports engine errors as res://file:line. Put print() calls in the code you are testing and read them back here. `run_frames` defaults to 0 (load only), or 120 when you pass `scene`; `timeout_seconds` caps each Godot run. Returns the errors and warnings with file:line, the totals and the printed output; an error result when Godot reports an error or is not installed. Your scenes and scripts are not changed: Godot updates its import cache in .godot/, where Godotwright also puts its checker script. Needs Godot on this machine and is slower than godot_review, so review first. To drive input and watch values use godot_play; for unit tests use godot_test.

path.description: The project folder, or any file or folder inside it (Godotwright walks up to project.godot). Relative paths start at the server's folder. Default: the current project.

run_frames.description: also run the main scene for this many frames and return its output (default 0; 120 when scene is given)

scene.description: run this scene (a res:// path) instead of the main scene

name: godot_check
title: Check with real Godot
